games.title: Pothole Dash
games.q: How far can you ride before the road wins?
games.d: A one-thumb scooter game on a different Bangalore road each day, starting with MG Road. Dodge potholes, cows, water tankers, BMTC buses and metro pillars, and watch for people stepping off the broken footpath. Three shock absorbers, then it's over. No sign-in, no ads.

games.title: Aunty, Help me please!
games.q: What does that office email actually mean?
games.d: Paste office jargon and a Punjabi aunty, Tamil mami, Bengali mashima or Gujarati masi tells you what it really means, in Hinglish or English. It works the other way too: "Beta, khana kha lo" becomes a corporate email. No sign-in.
